title: AI Sales Briefing
tagline: Prepare for every prospect conversation in minutes.
summary: Summarizes company information, review insights, website signals, CRM history, past emails, likely pain points, and suggested discovery questions before a sales call.
businessProblem: Reps join discovery calls underprepared — scrambling through LinkedIn, the company website, and CRM notes five minutes before the meeting, missing key context that could win the deal.
outcome: A one-page briefing delivered before each scheduled call: who they are, what hurts, what was said before, competitive context, and 5 tailored discovery questions.
whoItsFor: Account executives and founders who run multiple discovery calls per week and need consistent prep without a research analyst.
aiInputs: Upcoming calendar meeting with attendee names and company
CRM deal record, stage, and activity timeline
Last 3 email threads with the prospect
Prior call notes and meeting summaries
Public signals: website summary, review themes, news if available
aiOutputs: One-page briefing doc: company overview, key contacts, deal context
Likely pain points ranked by evidence strength
Summary of prior conversations and open items
5 suggested discovery questions tailored to their situation
Red flags or risks to probe (budget, timeline, competitor)
noCodeTools: ChatGPT with CRM export pasted before each call
Clay.com briefing column combining CRM + website + reviews
Zapier: Calendly booking → HubSpot pull → GPT → email briefing
lowCodeTools: n8n: morning cron → today's meetings → CRM + Gmail → Claude briefing → Slack
Google Calendar + Apps Script + OpenAI for daily prep doc
Make.com: Salesforce event trigger → enrichment → briefing to Outlook draft
customBuildStack: Calendar API poll for upcoming external meetings
CRM + Gmail aggregation per attendee domain
Slack or email delivery 1 hour before meeting
implementationSteps: Connect calendar, CRM, and email APIs with read-only scopes
Build briefing template sections: company, contacts, history, pains, questions
Add public enrichment: website scrape and review themes for unknown accounts
Deliver via Slack DM or email 60 minutes before each external meeting
Rep adds post-call notes; feed back into next briefing for follow-ups
Track briefing usage and correlate with meeting-to-next-step conversion
systemBehavior: Runs on calendar trigger — typically 1 hour before external meetings
Read-only on all systems — never modifies CRM or sends to prospect
Skips internal meetings and recurring standups
Flags low-confidence sections when data is sparse
Does not include confidential pricing from other deals
risks: Stale CRM data produces briefings that contradict reality on the call
Including incorrect AI-inferred pain points can embarrass the rep
Briefings with PII must not be posted to shared channels insecurely
Over-reliance on briefings reduces genuine curiosity on calls
